name: Barista

sections.daily_work: Prepare coffee and espresso drinks. Operate espresso machines and grinders. Serve customers, take orders, handle payments. Maintain a clean workspace. Recommend drinks.
sections.learning: Coffee knowledge (beans, roasts, brewing methods), espresso extraction, latte art, milk steaming, customer service, food safety, point-of-sale systems.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $12-$18/hour USD plus tips. Experienced baristas at specialty shops can earn $15-$25/hour plus tips. Managers earn more. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Apply at local coffee shops, SCA (Specialty Coffee Association) certification courses, barista training programs, starting as a counter person and training up.

try_in_real_life: Visit different coffee shops and observe their workflow
Try brewing coffee at home with different methods (pour-over, French press)
Ask a barista about their favorite part of the job
sources: Specialty Coffee Association industry reports; BLS food service data
